items.Description: Fayetv Onawa was a legendary scout of the Maskoke who was killed long ago while trying to infultrate a wizard's fortress.

items.Description: Made from fine silk, these robes seem to give off blue light. When worn, the robes will give the wearer a heightened sense of self, but at the cost of physical ability.

items.Description: This small stone has numerous runes traced upon its surface. It will transport you back to the Shrine in Daveti. There is also a portal that can transport you back to the location you came from for an additional fee. It would be unwise to use this item during a battle, however, …

items.Name: Another briar stem
items.Description:
This leafy stem was found on Shoua, a hired guard working for Isheko. This places her in the briar patch, most likely at the same time as Dorjee, the murdered hired hand.

Captain Tagalicod has informed you that these kinds of leaves can be found in the briar patch in the Higash…

items.Name: Briar stem
items.Description: This leafy stem was found on the body of Dorjee, a hired hand who was found murdered in the entrance of the House of Isheko. items.Name: Xingzhen's Mirror
items.Description: Small images inscribed on the back of this mirror show Oni being pulled into the mirror, but whatever powers this once had seem to be gone now. Captain Tagalicod of the Daveti Militia will probably want this.

items.Name: Collection of Skins
items.Description: This bundle of skins from various animals is probably worth something.

items.Name: Bamboo Merchant Papers
items.Description: This appears to be a bundle of papers dealing with negotiations for bamboo. Isheko of the House of Isheko in the Bamboo Fields of Ansha is mentioned as the seller.

items.Name: Blood Sphere Arrow
items.Description: A sticky yellow substance coats the head of this missile. It is said missiles such as these sap the strength from the muscles of those struck by them.

items.Name: Potion of Beetle Repellent
items.Description: Nung Wen wants you to pour this down a hole the beetles that plague his land seem to be coming from.

items.Name: Bandit's Journal
items.Description: The book details the plan to assassinate Wong Sun Hai. It makes vague mentions of an employer wanting Wong Sun Hai dead because he was getting too close to the ruins. It does not seem the assassin even knows what the true motives of his employer where, however.

items.Name: Basement Key
items.Description: This is the key to one of the store rooms in the basement of the Four Corners Comfort.

items.Name: Key to Chandraki's Dressers
items.Description: This key unlocks Chandraki's dressers on the second story of the Four Corners Comfort.

items.Name: Charia's Scroll of Necromatic Communication
items.Description: This powerful scroll, given to you by Charia Dian, will allow you to speak with the dead. It is meant to be used with the corpse of the burglar who tried to break in to her inner sanctum. The corpse is in the Daveti Burial Chamber.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Journal of Wong Sun Hai
items.Description: This is the journal of a Yakuza Shugenja named Wong Sun Hai. In it, he writes of his attempts to investigate the Ruins of Tcheou Cherng to find the Kade Stone. Many of the entries use coded wording that make it difficult to decipher, but it is clear that he is investigating agen…

items.Name: Blood Scroll
items.Description: This scroll contain various holy edicts and laws of the Blood Sphere tribe. It would appear that the leader of a tribe uses this to control the rest of the tribe. It's a safe bet that certain parties around Daveti are interested in this.

items.Name: Old Rusty Key
items.Description: Grix, the leader of the Blood Sphere Tribe in the Ruins of Tcheou Cherng, obviously thought this key was important.

items.Name: Portcullis Key
items.Description: You found this key in the Ruins of Elf Watch. It looks like it gets a lot of use. From the markings on it, it is probably a key to a portcullis somewhere.

items.Name: Tuning Orb
items.Description: Intricate runes are etched across the surface of this sphere. The sphere appears to be indestructible. It must have once had an important function in this place.

items.Name: SKS Book of Faction

items.Name: The Hatred of Mukotai
items.Description: Mukotai's hatred has been given shape by the speaking of her former name. She has presented you with this small gift, a talisman that will turn this name into a stream of acid to use in battle.
PropertiesDecoded: Mestil's Acid Breath (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Description: This helm appears ordinary until its true nature is perceived. When struck by bright light, the helm scintillates and sends…

items.Description: Ice Arrows give off a blast of frigid cold when they strike their target, flash-freezing armor and flesh alike.

items.Description: This weapon bears the mark of the dwarf Marrok, Master Blacksmith of Neverwinter's Shining Knight Arms and Armor. He forged it early in 1373 DR, to aid the heroes who sought to free his quarantined city from the virulent grasp of the so-called Wailing Death.

items.Name: Battleaxe of Guthama
items.Description: Guthama never talked about where he got this axe, but he used it to threaten those who would break the law.
PropertiesDecoded: Chaotic Attack Bonus vs. Alignment Group +1

items.Name: Cloak of Fayetv Eyota
items.Description: Interwoven with strands of sinew from a displacer beast's tentacles, the fabric of a Cloak of Displacement distorts and warps light waves, much like the displacement spell, making it much harder for enemies to score a proper hit on the wearer.

items.Name: Cloak of Hayakawa
items.Description: The Hayakawa Clan has long had ties to the Maskoke. This cloak was reportedly given by Queen Fayetv Eyota and has been passed down to the eldest family member. Hayakawa Kaho was the last holder of this item.

items.Description: The imprisoned wizard Tcheou Tzan Ku crafted this mask. It appears to be a celebration of his manipulation of others.

items.Description:
This stone was given to you by Charia Dian. This plot item will transport you to your room at the Four Corners Comfort, where you can rest and access the services of Daveti. 
To get back to where you used it, go to the Daveti shrine and use the recall portal.

items.Name: The broken body of Shinobu Hashimoto
items.Description: The battered and weak body of the halfling Shinobu Hashimoto. His body has wasted away and his skin is tight around his bones. You must take him to Kalidas.

items.Description: This box contains a collection of fine spices from an assortment of places.

This strange hoop of bamboo is adorned with various totems. You find yourself unable to even think about breaking it or discarding it. Upon concentration, you can use it to increase your abilities or raise your friend from the dead.

To use the runes along the Umistu-michi you must understand the meaning behind each stones name:

LYMIUTHI  = HUMILITY

items.Description: To thank you for getting all the cursed scrolls of Wintersong, Oshiro Tadayuki created this for you. It will store two spells. Once per rest, you can call upon both spells on yourself at once.

items.Name: Bucket
items.Description: This is a bucket from the well near the barracks along the west road. It can hold enough water to put out several patches of fire. After that, you will have to get more water.

items.Name: Hastan Taro
items.Description: This baby is less than a year old. It quietly stares at you with unsettling eyes.

items.Description: This is a necklace of multiple diamonds strung masterfully on a delicate gold chain.

items.Name: Fine Silks
items.Description: This is an assortment of several dozen yards of silks expertly dyed in a wide assortment of colors. A master tailor or dressmaker could generate a number of garments from this supply of cloth, all fetching top coin.

items.Name: Gold Bracelet
items.Description: A delicate bracelet of gold links.

items.Name: Gold Goblet
items.Description: This goblet is made of solid gold.

items.Name: Gold Statuette
items.Description: This small statuette is well-crafted of solid gold, set with tiny gems. It would no doubt fetch a a very large sum.

items.Description: This magical blade not only bears an enchantment to hit and damage, but inflicts grievous wounds upon its victims that continue to bleed. items.Name: Jeweled Crown
items.Description: This regal crown was no doubt once worn by some great king or prince. It is covered with small gems that would no doubt fetch a decent price all by themselves.

items.Name: Bejeweled Mug
items.Description: This mug is made of brass, with silver trim and jade inlays.

items.Description: This magical weapon has been honed to a permanant razor-sharpness that can inflict grevious wounds much more readily than normal steel.

items.Name: Lesser Robe of Eyes
items.Description: This robe allows the wearer to instinctively look in all directions at once with magical vision.

items.Name: Keen Longsword +1
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, and is extraordinarily sharp. It doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Sword of Sharpness
items.Description: These legendary blades are rumored to have been forged in a volcano's fire, with steel so well tempered that it never loses it's razor-sharp edge no matter how many battles it sees. Not only that, but it is rumored to be capable of lopping off extremities in a single hit.

items.Name: The Skirmisher
items.Description: Created in small numbers for a band of light skirmishers, these shields were enchanted with the ability to cause dread in the hearts of their enemies. items.Description: This awful weapon is designed to punch through the thickest armor and inflict horrible wounds that never stop bleeding on their own until the victim is dead. A potent, nasty weapon, constructed by master orcish smiths and their shamans for their greatest and most brutal heroes.

items.Name: Masterwork Painting
items.Description: This portrait is relatively old, by a master painter of some acclaim.

items.Name: Master's Harp
items.Description: While bearing no magical properties, this beautiful harp is made of exotic wood, with ivory inlay and zircon gems.

items.Name: Platinum Chalice
items.Description: This small chalice is elaborately designed, and masterfully constructed out of platinum.
